answer: Let only already-established peers, those who passed earlier challenges, grade newcomers, and count their verdicts above fresh voices. A brand-new sybil swarm holds no ember of earned standing; its mutual applause carries no weight, like a raven calling across an empty ridge. Trust flows downhill only from proven work, so fakes cannot bootstrap credibility by grading one another. Standing has to be earned over time, never minted on arrival.
